name: Ueno Shin'ya
source:
Shuichi's colleague and close friend, having joined the company in the same year.

Although they work in different departments, they occasionally go out for drinks together after work.

Since they joined the company at the same time, he has known Nanami well ever since the days when she and Shuichi were dating.

He likes to put on the airs of a carefree bachelor enjoying the single life. However, seeing how happy Shuichi is in his married life, he secretly feels increasingly anxious about his own situation.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
